meta.name: add-discord
meta.description: Add Discord bot channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Discord 机器人频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Discord 机器人消息通道。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Discord bot channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add a Discord bot channel to your application.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能通过你创建的 Discord 机器人,在你的服务器频道或私信中收发消息,你可以在 Discord 里直接和它对话。集成需要你先按指引建好 Discord 应用并授权。
howto.when: 当你说要添加 Discord 集成/频道,或要求连接 Discord 机器人时,这个流程会接管,逐步完成配置。

say.text: 帮我添加 Discord 集成
say.note: 它会把 Discord 适配器装好并开始配置。

say.text: 连接我的 Discord 机器人
say.note: 需要你提供机器人令牌等凭证。
它会引导你创建应用、邀请机器人等步骤。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can send and receive messages via your Discord bot in server channels or DMs, so you can chat with it directly in Discord. The integration requires you to set up a Discord app and authorize the bot.
howto.when_en: This flow takes over when you ask to add Discord integration/channel, or request to connect your Discord bot, then completes the setup step by step.

say_en.note: It installs the adapter and starts configuration.
You'll be asked for the bot token etc.
It guides you through creating an app and inviting the bot.
